verdict: Yes. BLFabric from Surat pitched fabric retail on Shark Tank India Season 4 and got a deal. Home tailors, boutiques and small designers buy fabric online, and Surat's cluster gives access to huge variety at low prices.
angle: Many Indians still get clothes stitched by a tailor, and small boutiques need fabric in small quantities. Selling fabric by the metre online with good photos and swatches serves both. Accurate colour photos reduce returns.
